svg.text: ODGS IMPLEMENTATION CONFORMANCE LEVELS (L1 CORE & L2 ATTESTED)
Progression from Documentary Governance to Deterministic Runtime Enforcement and Cryptographic Attestation
DOCUMENTARY & CONTROL-PLANE BASELINE
Stage 1 · Catalogue & Inventory Baseline
• Datasets catalogued with basic metadata and ownership
• Typical Artefacts: Written policy documents, data inventories,
business glossaries, manual compliance checklists
Mode: Manual / Documentary
Stage 2 · Pre-Transfer Contract Negotiation
• Participant identity and access rights negotiated prior to transfer
via Dataspace Control Plane connectors
• Typical Artefacts: W3C ODRL 2.2 Agreements, Verifiable
Credentials, periodic retrospective audit reports
Mode: Pre-Transfer Authorization
ODGS RUNTIME CONFORMANCE (LEVEL 1 CORE & LEVEL 2 ATTESTED)
ODGS Level 1 Core · Declarative Schema & Ontology Conformance
• Planes II–IV JSON artifacts validate against Draft-07 JSON Schemas (01–03)
• Data quality dimensions grounded in ISO/IEC 25012 & ISO 8000-8
• Verified via: odgs conformance --level L1
Guarantees Structural & Semantic Decoupling
ODGS Level 2 Attested · Deterministic PEP & Cryptographic S-Cert
• Full cross-reference integrity across context_bindings.json (ISO/IEC 38505-1 EDM)
• Deterministic HARD_STOP / SOFT_STOP / LOG_ONLY runtime gate in data pipeline
• Emits RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical S-Cert (04-s-cert-schema.json) & Eclipse CAP VC
• Verified via: odgs conformance --level L2
Mode: Deterministic Runtime Control & Zero-Knowledge Cryptographic Evidence
